When we experience intense emotions, whether positive or negative, time can seem to either slow down or speed up. This is often described as time "slowing down" during emergencies or high-stress situations, where every second feels elongated.

This is why moments of happiness or excitement often feel fleeting, as we are less aware of time passing.
